transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you to see me today?

Hi. Well, I came in because for the past few weeks, I've just felt this... this heavy, sad pressure sitting on me pretty much all day. Even when I'm at work and I'm smiling at my patients, inside I just feel like I'm barely holding myself together.
Along with that heavy, sad feeling, have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah, I have. Usually, after my shifts, I would paint, or maybe go to yoga or salsa to decompress. But lately... I just go straight home and sit on the couch. I've been ignoring my texts, too, because honestly, none of it really feels worth the effort anymore.
Have you ever experienced a period of feeling this low before in your life?

No, I haven't. I mean, I've had stressful weeks at the clinic before, or just regular bad days, but it always passed. This is... this is the first time it's been this heavy and just hasn't gone away. So, no, I've never experienced anything quite like this before.
Have you ever had periods where you felt the opposite—unusually energized, wired, or on top of the world, needing very little sleep?

No, not at all. I mean, I've had good days where I feel rested and productive, but... never anything like being wired or not needing sleep. I definitely need my sleep, especially with my shifts at the clinic. So, no, I haven't ever experienced anything like that.
Did any specific life event, major change, or stressful situation happen around the time these feelings began?
Yeah, there was. Um... I found out I'm pregnant. This whole feeling has been going on for about three weeks now, basically starting right after I got the news.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep patterns over these past few weeks?

No, not really. I mean, my sleep has been pretty much the same as usual. I still go to bed and wake up around my normal times for my shifts at the clinic. So, I haven't noticed any real changes there.
Have you been struggling with feelings of worthlessness, or feeling like you're letting people down or blaming yourself?

No, not really. I mean, I don't feel worthless or anything like that. I haven't been blaming myself or feeling like I'm letting people down at the clinic or at home. It's just... I don't know, I just feel really low, but I don't have those kinds of thoughts about myself.
Have you noticed any changes in your energy levels, or have you been feeling unusually tired or drained during the day?

No, I haven't really noticed a difference there. I mean, I get tired after a long shift at the clinic, but that's always been normal for me. I wouldn't say I feel unusually drained or anything during the day. My energy is pretty much the same as it usually is.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight over these past few weeks?

Yeah, actually, my appetite has been off. I mean, I know I should be eating regularly, but most days food just sounds really unappealing to me right now. I'll be halfway through a shift at the clinic and suddenly realize that I’ve only had, like, coffee or a few crackers all day.
Have you noticed any difficulty concentrating, focusing on tasks, or making decisions recently?

Yeah, I definitely have. My brain just feels really foggy lately. At work, I keep having to reread medication orders and wound-care notes because the information just doesn't sink in the first time. And... I don't know, decisions that I normally make automatically just make me freeze up now. I end up second-guessing myself on things I do every day.
Have you had any thoughts of harming yourself, or that you might be better off not being here?

Yeah, I have. That's actually what scared me enough to say something at my prenatal appointment. I don't have any kind of plan to hurt myself, but... I have been having these thoughts lately where I just wish I wouldn't wake up in the morning.
